parts.html: The K-42 kitchen model combines a contemporary L-shaped layout with light cream-beige upper cabinets and deep dark blue lower cabinetry. Tall units on the right continue the dark blue finish, forming a strong vertical element and visually completing the kitchen composition.

The main design feature is the contrast between a light upper section and a richer, darker lower section. The cream-beige cabinets make the upper row appear visually lighter, while the dark blue lower fronts give the design depth and character.
A vertical open shelving section is integrated within the tall cabinetry on the right. This creates a transition between closed storage and open display space for tableware and decorative objects.
The very dark countertop establishes a strong horizontal line, while the light backsplash has a vertical textured surface that adds detail without introducing another strong color.
Layout and dimensions
K-42 has an L-shaped configuration, with cabinetry arranged along two adjoining walls.
Its total linear length is 4.8 meters, with standard dimensions of 4.8 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

The kitchen is designed for built-in household appliances. Their final selection and positioning are determined during individual planning. Built-in appliance compatibility does not mean the appliances themselves are automatically included with the furniture.
A separate kitchen island is not part of the standard specification.
Materials and finishes
Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard.
The upper cabinetry has a light cream-beige finish, while the lower fronts and tall units on the right are deep dark blue.
The cabinet structure uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
The countertop is chipboard-based, with a very dark decorative finish.
Hardware and storage
A pull-out cargo storage system is included as standard.
Hinged cabinet doors use Hettich hinges with soft-close.
Pull-out elements use Quadro Hettich concealed runners.
Cabinet handles are included.
Lift mechanisms are not included in the standard specification.
Optional upgrades
Upon request, K-42 can be equipped with more functional furniture hardware, alternative opening mechanisms, and additional internal storage systems.
Alternative materials are also available, ranging from budget-friendly solutions to premium finishes. These choices are optional and are specified separately from the standard K-42 configuration.
